families.name: Action
families.desc: Action Dudes may get knocked down, but they always come back in the third act to save the world.

families.name: Employed
families.desc: Employed Dudes have the tools and the know-how to get the job done right the third time. First time if the pay is good.

families.name: Fantasy
families.desc: Fantasy Dudes use magic and otherworldly abilities to empower themselves and each other.

families.name: Sci-Fi
families.desc: Sci-Fi Dudes use advanced technology and definitely realistic gadgets to gain the upper hand in any situation.

families.name: Sports
families.desc: Sports Dudes are just in it for the love of the game, and hopefully some sick sponsorship deals.

families.name: Undead
families.desc: Undead Dudes thrive in chaos and are completely unbothered when their fellow Dudes fall in combat.

families.name: Warrior
families.desc: Warrior Dudes use precision and coordinated attacks to work together and outsmart their opponents.
